items.description: Tenant may terminate the Lease if the Commencement Date Conditions have not occurred by the Outside Completion Date, subject to Force Majeure extension and the conditions that follow.
items.span_text: 2.2.1.2 If the Commencement Date Conditions have not occurred prior to the Outside Completion Date, subject to extension by virtue of Force Majeure, Tenant shall have the right to terminate this Lease, provided that:
items.trigger: If the Commencement Date Conditions have not occurred prior to the Outside Completion Date

items.description: Tenant must give Landlord notice of termination before the earlier of completion of the Commencement Date Conditions or ten business days after the Outside Completion Date.
items.span_text: (a) Tenant notifies Landlord of such termination prior to the earlier to occur of: (1) completion of the Commencement Date Conditions; or (2) ten (10) business days after the Outside Completion Date; and

items.description: Landlord must use commercially reasonable efforts to complete installation of the ladder racking system and the StarLine Busway System after the Commencement Date.
items.span_text: Landlord agrees to use commercially reasonable efforts to cause Landlord’s installation of the ladder racking system and the StarLine Busway System (each, as described on Exhibit “E”) to be completed after the Commencement Date.

items.description: Landlord must use commercially reasonable efforts to complete installation of the hot-aisle containment system after the parties reasonably agree on its layout.
items.span_text: 2.2.2.2 Landlord agrees to use commercially reasonable efforts to cause Landlord’s installation of the hot-aisle containment system (as described on Exhibit “E”) to be completed after Landlord and Tenant have reasonably agreed on the layout of such system.
items.trigger: after Landlord and Tenant have reasonably agreed on the layout of such system

items.description: During Early Access, Tenant must comply with all Lease terms except paying Base Rent.
items.span_text: Tenant’s Early Access shall be subject to (and, during such period, Tenant must comply with) all of the terms and provisions of this Lease, excepting only the payment of Base Rent.

items.description: Tenant must pay all electricity charges accruing to the Premises during the Early Access Period.
items.span_text: (b) while Tenant shall not be required to pay Base Rent during the Early Access Period, Tenant shall be required to pay any and all electricity charges that accrue to the Premises during the Early Access Period.

items.anchor_event: then applicable expiration date of the Term
items.description: To exercise an Extension Option, Tenant must deliver an Extension Option Exercise Notice within the window of nine to twelve calendar months before the Term expires.
items.span_text: Tenant may exercise each such Extension Option only by delivering an Extension Option Exercise Notice to Landlord at least nine (9) calendar months (and not more than twelve (12) calendar months) prior to the then applicable expiration date of the Term

items.description: Upon Tenant's valid exercise of an Extension Option, both parties must sign an amendment reflecting it.
items.span_text: If Tenant duly exercises an Extension Option, Landlord and Tenant shall execute an amendment reflecting such exercise.
items.trigger: If Tenant duly exercises an Extension Option
